metas.name: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
metas.description: A seemingly flawless family at House No. 47 unravels after an incident reveals hidden tensions.

metas.name: Biker
metas.description: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.

metas.name: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
metas.description: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son.

metas.name: Hi Nanna
metas.description: Six-year-old Mahi, a spirited child with cystic fibrosis, shares a deep yet complex bond with her father, Viraj, a dedicated single parent and successful fashion photographer. Her curiosity about her absent mother leads to a journey of discovery when she runs away with her loyal dog, Pluto. A chance encounter with a kind woman named Yashna sparks unexpected revelations, intertwining their lives in ways they never anticipated. Set against a backdrop of love, sacrifice, and redemption, Mahi’s story is a heartfelt exploration of family, resilience, and the enduring power of connection.

metas.name: Ante... Sundaraniki!
metas.description: A man from a Brahmin family falls in love with a Christian girl. In order to convince their parents, they say contrasting lies which complicates the situation and leads to a comedy of errors.

metas.name: Happy Journey
metas.description: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.

metas.name: Govindudu Andarivaadele
metas.description: Balaraju, the head of his village, lives with his wife Baby along with his two sons Chandrasekhar Rao and Bangari and two daughters. He helps Chandrasekhar become a doctor and builds a local hospital. On the day it opens, Chandrasekhar comes back home with his lover Kausalya, also a doctor. Both express their wish to marry and settle abroad, which upsets Balaraju, leading to their separation.  25 years later, Chandrasekhar, a successful doctor in London, tells the story to his son Abhiram and daughter Indu. Abhiram decides to go home to Balaraju and attempt a reconciliation. He meets his friend, Bunny, at the airport and goes to the village on Bunny's bike the next day.

metas.name: Godari Gattupaina
metas.description: In the picturesque Godavari villages, a kind-hearted auto driver and a spirited college girl fall in love, but their bond is tested by her father's expectations and unforeseen challenges.

metas.name: Welcome obama
metas.description: Yashoda agrees to be a surrogate mother to Lucy, an American lady. Unfortunately, during her pregnancy, Yashoda meets with an accident which jeopardises the child's life.

metas.name: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
metas.description: Venky and Nandini's relationship changes from mere friendship to something that is more romantic. However, love only blossoms between the two after Nandini's marriage is fixed elsewhere.

metas.name: Hello!
metas.description: Avinash/Seenu is a street urchin brought up by his loving adoptive parents Saru and Prakash. The love of his life is the girl he meets during childhood Junnu/Priya, whom fate had snatched away from him. Fourteen long years and they still wait for the day they will meet again. Will destiny help them?

metas.name: Oopiri
metas.description: Impressed by his carefree attitude, quadriplegic multi-billionaire Vikram hires a convict out on parole as his caretaker. What follows is a string of life lessons they learn from each other.

metas.name: Manam
metas.description: A married couple die in an accident, leaving behind a son. As he grows up and becomes successful, he comes across reincarnations of his father and mother as youngsters, and vows to bring them back together.

metas.name: A Aa
metas.description: The love affair, conspired by creation, between Anasuya Ramalingam and Aanand Vihari.

metas.name: Monalisa
metas.description: A lovable NRI whose unfiltered honesty has sabotaged every relationship he's ever had gets one last chance at love when he sets out to win the heart of his best friend before an arranged marriage takes her away.

metas.name: Oh! Baby
metas.description: A 70-year-old woman transforms into her 24-year-old self after she's photographed at a studio, changing her life and those of the people around her forever.

metas.name: Son of Satyamurthy
metas.description: The son of a rich businessman struggles to save his father's wealth after his demise. However, he faces many challenges when he becomes the sole breadwinner of his family.

metas.name: Cinema Chupista Maava
metas.description: Kaththi (played by Raj Tharun) is a happy-go-lucky boy, who enjoys life with his friends. But, his father always scolds him as he fails Intermediate two times. One day, he falls in love with Parineeti (played by Avika Gor), who is the daughter of Somnath Chaterjee (played by Rao Ramesh).  With his tricks and techniques, Kaththi makes Parineeti to fall in love with him. The twist in the tale rises when Somnath Chaterjee comes to know about their relationship. In order to get marry with his daughter, Somanath keeps a challenge for Kaththi and he promises that he will give his daughter to him, if he passes the test.  What is the challenge given by Somanth Chaterjee? What did Kaththi do for his love? What is the twist in the story forms the rest of the story.

metas.name: Hello Guru Prema Kosame
metas.description: After a rocky start, a friendship develops between a happy-go-lucky youth and a girl from the city.

metas.name: Seethamma Vakitlo Sirimalle Chettu
metas.description: An exuberant and evocative family drama, that primarily revolves around the close bond between two brothers with radically different personalities, highlighting the complex process of choosing an ideal life partner for each of them.

metas.name: Suyodhana
metas.description: A young Foley artist has grown up hearing a mysterious voice called Suyodhana and often visualises a figure resembling Duryodhana. Raised by his mother and supported by his childhood friend and partner, his life takes a turn when he is accused of his father’s murder, leading to an investigation that uncovers deeper layers of his past.

metas.name: Subhapradam
metas.description: Shubhapradham (Telugu: శుభప్రదం) is a film directed by veteran director K. Vishwanath, starring Allari Naresh and Manjari Phadnis.

metas.name: Ready
metas.description: A brave man decides to kidnap his friend's beloved from a forced marriage, but ends up abducting the wrong bride. Ironically, the bride he kidnapped is ecstatic because she was already planning an escape. On the run, they fall in love, but in order to get married, they must convince their families.

metas.name: Needi Naadi Oke Katha
metas.description: Sagar  is a happy-go-lucky student who has no interest in his studies at all. Son of a teacher, he feels the pressure put on him by his father and the society both. But what happens when he fails to live up to their expectations?

metas.name: Andhra King Taluka
metas.description: A heartfelt tribute to fan culture, the story follows Sagar, an ardent fan whose life, relationships, and identity revolve around his admiration for his cinematic idol, 'Andhra King' Surya Kumar.

metas.name: Parugu
metas.description: A group of friends are forcibly transported to a village and kept imprisoned, as the village head, who believes that they have helped in his daughter's elopement with her lover.

metas.name: Beauty
metas.description: A moving and suspenseful tale of a father`s unshakable love. When his daughter suddenly goes missing, his world is turned upside down. What begins as a desperate search soon becomes a gripping journey filled with questions of trust, innocence, and the true meaning of unconditional love. A film that belongs to everyone, Beauty explores a parent`s relentless hope and the lengths they will go to for their child.

metas.name: Pelli SandaD
metas.description: Is a young man's will power and a young woman's destiny enough for them to be together?

metas.name: Ninnu Kori
metas.description: Pallavi invites Uma, her ex-boyfriend, to stay with her and her husband to convince him that she is happy in her marriage. Uma tries to create a rift between the couple, hoping to win Pallavi back.

metas.name: Devadasu
metas.description: Landlord Narayan Rao's son Devdasu and Parvathi, their poor neighbour's daughter, fall in love. But Devadas's family does not approve of the relationship.

metas.name: The Family Star
metas.description: Govardhan, a devoted architect from Hyderabad, juggles supporting his extended family while seeking a partner who understands his commitments. When he discovers Indu thesis on his family, he challenges her, leading to unexpected twists as they navigate misunderstandings and eventually find love amidst sacrifice and understanding
